children: on Monday said it would acquire World Labs, an AI model and research lab, in an all-stock transaction is valued at nearly $8.2 billion.

Led by AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li, San Francisco-based World Labs develops spatial-intelligence models that generate, reconstruct and simulate interactive 3D environments from text, image and video inputs, as well as technology for robotic learning and simulation.

“The acquisition will bring a world-class team of researchers and model experts to AMD, strengthening its ability to develop AI hardware, software and systems around the needs of emerging models and applications,” AMD
, adding that the deal will help AMD advance its strategy to deliver AI infrastructure for an open ecosystem.

Following the close of the transaction, the World Labs team will continue to focus on advancing AI model research, and Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting to Lisa Su.

Li, who has been referred to as the "godmother of AI," has extensive experience in the tech industry. She previously served on the board of directors at Twitter (now known as X), as an executive at Google Cloud (
), and as the director of Stanford University's AI Lab from 2013 to 2018.
The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026.
Shares of AMD closed nearly 4% lower on Monday at $608.14.

title: AMD to acquire World Labs in $8.2B all-stock deal
